JC.name: James Clear
JC.why: Makes behavior change tangible through repeatable actions and workable environments.
JC.boundary: Author-inspired practical scenarios; no claim that a habit system guarantees success or overrides resources.

CD.name: Carol Dweck
CD.book: Mindset: The New Psychology of Success
CD.why: Adds a research-based account of beliefs about learning, setbacks, feedback and support.
CD.boundary: Growth mindset is not effort alone or an unlimited-ability promise. Adult workplace and family applications are editorial extensions, not direct study findings for every situation.

VF.name: Viktor Frankl
VF.why: Adds meaning, dignity and responsibility to the thinking-reset theme.
VF.lane: Meaning, connection and choices within limits
VF.boundary: Meaning is personal; do not prescribe it to someone else, romanticize suffering or imply that attitude removes coercion, illness or material barriers. These videos do not teach clinical logotherapy techniques.

DC.name: Dale Carnegie
DC.book: How to Win Friends and Influence People; How to Stop Worrying and Start Living
DC.why: Connects personal change with everyday communication, trust and practical decisions.
DC.boundary: Respectful communication does not require tolerating abuse or controlling another person. Current training-organization commentary is labeled separately from original book material.

production_template: Explain one mechanism or distinction in plain language
Animate the specific direction supplied for this idea
Close with one practical reflection and readable credits
style_rules: Use Avatars terminology and original diverse characters.
Use the existing VisionWeaver Cast, Character Detail Specifications and 360 View reference workflow.
Preserve approved clothing, physical details, locations and causal continuity.
Draw from everyday homes, workplaces, community spaces and learning settings.
Render captions and exact labels in editing rather than generative footage.
Credit author inspiration separately from technical psychology sources.
No fabricated quotations, author impersonation or guaranteed outcomes.
source_boundary: Source links anchor broad themes only. The 300 titles, scenarios and animation directions are original editorial creations. Research findings are not treated as proving every proposed application. Some Carnegie pages were available only as indexed excerpts. Technical definitions and exact quotations require episode-level checking before publication.
